item.title: PostgreSQL String Types: TEXT vs. VARCHAR vs. CHAR Performance and Usage
item.description:
“PostgreSQL String Types: TEXT vs. VARCHAR vs. CHAR Performance and Usage”

When structuring data in PostgreSQL, selecting the appropriate string data type—TEXT, VARCHAR(n), or CHAR(n)—is a common point of consideration. Does specifying a length (VARCHAR(n)) offer performance benefits or drawbacks compared to the unrestricted TEXT type? How do these types stack up internally regarding memory use and speed?

Performance and Storage Implications of PostgreSQL String Types

What are the fundamental differences in performance and storage between PostgreSQL’s string types?
